about.title: About DTP
about.body: DTP (Digital Traveller Profile) helps tourists manage borders, stays, flights, and local discovery in one place. Built by DTP Support Services Corp.

contact.title: Contact Us
contact.body: Questions about your trip or the demo app? Reach out and we will get back to you.

workWithUs.title: Work with Us
workWithUs.body: Hospitality partners can access anonymized traveller insights to improve services. Business features are coming soon in this demo.
